import type { StepIndicatorContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class StepIndicator extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        steps: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        mode: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    steps: StepIndicatorContract['steps'];
    mode: NonNullable<StepIndicatorContract['mode']>;
    constructor();
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
